text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the trouble, Nakayama<n>Festa. I see
that your game was not<n>in violation of school
rules.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now hold on just a second. An<n>apology's not
gonna cut it, Prez.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: If time is money, then you just costme big time. On account of yourscrewup, to boot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It only seems fair that you<n>compensate me for my
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Are you trying to threaten me?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, I wouldn't dream of it. Justfloating a suggestion. But if you didwant to settle this fair and square... Isure wouldn't say no.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Emperors don't steal from others<n>and run, do
they? They'd just be<n>tyrants in that case.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. It seems I have no room to<n>back down
gracefully.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well, I accept. What is it you<n>want?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Chess. You can take white.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You'd give me the first move,<n>knowing how
experienced a player I<n>am? You're either
audacious or<n>simply foolhardy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm just in it for the love of the game,<n>Prez. All I
want is to go toe to toe, no<n>holds barred.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Now, let's get started, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This time, I'll play white. Let's see<n>what you
make... of this!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(She sacrificed her pawn... She's<n>playing the
King's Gambit!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how I move, I'll get<n>bogged down in a
melee. This game<n>is...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Chaos! Disorder! Heh heh heh!Now we're playing chess!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And that's a wrap. Guess that's why<n>you're the
best, Prez. Still, I've had<n>my fun.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Next time I've got some time to kill,<n>maybe I'll
come steal some of yours.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I eked out a win, in the end. Still...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: (What a game! My fingertips are still<n>tingling!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am in your debt, Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now my mind feels as sharp as a<n>freshly honed
blade!
